name: Plan termination / deconversion
description: Sponsor ends the relationship (moving to a successor provider or terminating the plan).

steps.name: Validate termination request
steps.guidance: Must include reason, requested effective date and successor provider (if deconverting).

steps.name: Verify termination authorization
steps.guidance: A termination or deconversion must be authorized by the plan sponsor's governing body.

steps.name: Calculate termination fees
steps.guidance: Calculates the flat deconversion fee, the per-participant fee and the asset-based fee prorated to the effective date. Check the result against the contract before it is quoted to the sponsor.

steps.name: Send blackout notice to sponsor for participant distribution
steps.guidance: Participants must get at least 30 (and no more than 60) days' notice of a blackout period of more than 3 business days, which is typical during a deconversion.

steps.name: Send termination confirmation with final fees
steps.guidance: Confirm the effective date, blackout window and final fees in writing.

steps.name: Terminate plan on recordkeeper (TRAC)
steps.guidance: Marks the plan as terminated on the recordkeeper with the effective date and successor provider.
